headline: Private hospitals must set up labour rooms by July 11 or face legal action
summary: The DGHS has issued a directive to reduce unnecessary C-sections and encourage normal deliveries across Bangladesh.
details: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) has directed all private hospitals and clinics to establish labour rooms by July 11.
Health Minister Sardar Md Sakhawat Husain warned that the licenses of facilities that fail to comply with the deadline will be revoked.
The move is specifically aimed at reducing the number of unnecessary C-sections and encouraging more normal deliveries.
The DGHS issued a formal letter to the Bangladesh Private Medical College Association and the Bangladesh Private Hospital Clinic Diagnostic Owners Association.
Facilities must establish these labour rooms according to an official inspection checklist to avoid legal action.

headline: Free govt books sold for 10k to 25k BDT in some areas
summary: Allegations surface that free textbooks provided by the government are being illegally sold to parents for high prices.
details: Allegations have emerged that free government textbooks are being illegally sold to students and parents for prices ranging from 10,000 to 25,000 BDT.
These books are intended to be distributed free of charge to students across the country to ensure accessible education.
Reports suggest that some middlemen or unauthorized sellers are intercepting the supply chain to profit from the books.
The incident has caused significant distress among parents, particularly those from low-income families who cannot afford such high costs.
Authorities are being urged to investigate the distribution process to identify the culprits and prevent further illegal sales.
